messages.content: Check my code base and make a report how to improve the legacy code?

**Reasoning:**
- The provided documentation is a Maven POM file only, not actual source code
- No source code files are accessible in the workspace for analysis
- POM configuration issues can be identified, but code-level improvements require source code review

**Solution:**

Based on the available POM documentation, here are identified issues:

```xml
<!-- Issues found in POM configuration -->
<properties>
    <!-- Issue 1: Outdated logging versions -->
    <slf4jVersion>1.6.1</slf4jVersion>        <!-- Should be 1.7.x or 2.x -->
    <logback.version>1.0.1</logback.version> <!-- Should be 1.2.x or higher -->
    
    <!-- Issue 2: Java version mismatch -->
    <maven.compiler.source>1.8</maven.compiler.source>
    <maven.compiler.target>1.8</maven.compiler.target>
    <!-- Project name suggests Java 11+ but compiles to 1.8 -->
    
    <!-- Issue 3: Ignite version is old -->
    <ignite.version>2.14.0</ignite.version> <!-- Consider upgrading -->
</properties>
```

**Justification:**
- SLF4J 1.6.1 is from 2012; modern projects use 1.7.36+ or 2.x
- Logback 1.0.1 is outdated; 1.2.11+ recommended
- Java 8 compilation targets are legacy; Java 11+ is current standard
- Ignite 2.14.0 is from 2017; newer versions available

**Recommendations:**
- Update logging dependencies to current versions
- Consider bumping Java compilation target to 11 or 17
- Review Ignite version compatibility with your use case
- Add missing dependencies (H2 database was commented out)

**Note:** I cannot analyze actual code quality without access to source files in the workspace. Please provide source code files for a complete legacy code improvement report.
